offerings.name: Google Search API (SERP API)
offerings.pricing: Starter $50 / 50k credits ($1.00/1k); Standard $375 / 500k credits ($0.75/1k); Scale $1250 / 2.5M credits ($0.50/1k); Ultimate $3750 / 12.5M credits ($0.30/1k). Top-up model, no monthly subscriptions; 价格不含销售税/VAT/GST。
offerings.price_basis: Starter（50,000 credits，$1.00/1k）；量级越大单价越低，最低 $0.30/1k
offerings.free_quota: Get 2,500 free queries / Try 2,500 queries for free。No credit card required
offerings.output_type: 结构化 Google SERP 结果（Search / Images / News / Maps / Places / Videos / Shopping / Scholar / Patents / Autocomplete 等 JSON 输出）
offerings.note: 每次成功响应扣 1 credit，credit 有效期 6 个月；速率 50–300 queries per second；实时查询不缓存，1–2 秒返回；7 天内且用量未超 20% 可全额退款。
